description.en: Any GLB/glTF model, SVG, or image floating in a studio scene, redrawn as shape-matched ASCII characters.
description.zh: 让任意 GLB/glTF 模型、SVG 或图片悬浮在影棚场景中，并以贴合轮廓的 ASCII 字符重绘。

discovery.caveat: 需准备目标模型、SVG 或图片；渲染器要求见详情。

notice.en: Reference entry. This AI catalog does not redistribute component source. Install directly from the author's registry under its license; the @canvas-ui namespace belongs to the upstream author.
notice.zh: 来源收藏条目。本 AI 目录不重新分发组件源码；如需使用，请遵守作者许可并直接从作者的注册表安装。@canvas-ui 属于上游作者。

description.en: URL of the asset to display: GLB/glTF, SVG, PNG, JPEG, WebP, or GIF. Object URLs from a file input work too. The format is sniffed from the bytes, not the extension. Draco-compressed models are supported via a decoder fetched on demand, and flat art is mounted as a card lit by the same studio.
description.zh: 要显示的素材网址：支持 GLB/glTF、SVG、PNG、JPEG、WebP 或 GIF，也支持文件输入生成的对象 URL。通过字节识别格式，而不依赖扩展名。Draco 压缩模型会按需加载解码器，二维素材则作为卡片放入同一灯光场景。

description.en: Render the object as ASCII characters. Turn off to see the raw render.
description.zh: 将物体渲染为 ASCII 字符。关闭后显示原始渲染。

description.en: Height of one character cell in CSS pixels.
description.zh: 单个字符单元的高度，单位为 CSS 像素。

description.en: Width of a character cell relative to its height (0.35 to 1.25).
description.zh: 字符单元宽度相对于高度的比例（0.35 至 1.25）。

description.en: Characters the renderer may choose from. Each character's shape is measured and matched against the underlying render, so glyphs like / and _ land on matching edges. A space is always available for empty cells.
description.zh: 渲染器可使用的字符。每个字符的形状都会与底层画面匹配，让 /、_ 等字符落在相应边缘。空白单元始终可以使用空格。

description.en: Tint each character with the scene color underneath it. Turn off for a single-color look.
description.zh: 使用下方场景颜色为每个字符着色。关闭后使用单色。

description.en: Character color used when colored is off.
description.zh: colored 关闭时使用的字符颜色。

description.en: Tone contrast of the character selection. 1 keeps the original tones, higher values deepen shadows.
description.zh: 字符选择的明暗对比度。1 保留原始色调，更高的值会加深阴影。

description.en: How strongly characters snap to edges and contours of the object. 1 turns the effect off.
description.zh: 字符贴合物体边缘和轮廓的程度。1 表示关闭此效果。

description.en: Brightness multiplier applied before characters are chosen.
description.zh: 选择字符前应用的亮度倍数。

description.en: Invert the object tones so dark areas get the dense characters.
description.zh: 反转物体明暗，使暗部使用更密集的字符。

description.en: Background color behind the characters. Leave empty for a transparent canvas.
description.zh: 字符后方的背景色。留空时画布透明。

description.en: Accent color of the ring light in the studio environment.
description.zh: 工作室环境中环形灯的强调色。

description.en: Brightness of the studio environment lighting.
description.zh: 工作室环境光亮度。

description.en: Roughness override applied to every material (0 to 1). Negative keeps the asset's own values.
description.zh: 对所有材质应用的粗糙度覆盖值（0 至 1）；负值保留素材自身的设置。

description.en: Size of the longest side of the object in scene units. The camera sits about 4 units away.
description.zh: 物体最长边的场景单位尺寸。相机距离约为 4 个单位。

description.en: Horizontal offset of the object in scene units.
description.zh: 物体水平偏移，单位为场景单位。

description.en: Vertical offset of the object in scene units.
description.zh: 物体垂直偏移，单位为场景单位。

description.en: Strength of the floating bob animation (0 disables).
description.zh: 上下漂浮动画的强度（0 关闭）。

description.en: Strength of the idle rocking rotation (0 disables).
description.zh: 闲置摇摆旋转的强度（0 关闭）。

description.en: Speed of the float and rocking animation.
description.zh: 漂浮与摇摆动画的速度。

description.en: Let the user orbit the camera by dragging.
description.zh: 允许用户拖动以环绕观察物体。

description.en: Let the user zoom with the scroll wheel or pinch.
description.zh: 允许用户使用滚轮或双指手势缩放。

description.en: Spin the camera around the object turntable-style.
description.zh: 让相机像转台一样环绕物体旋转。

description.en: Turntable speed when autoRotate is on.
description.zh: autoRotate 开启时的转台速度。

description.en: Camera field of view in degrees.
description.zh: 相机视场角，单位为度。

description.en: Camera distance from the center of the object.
description.zh: 相机到物体中心的距离。

description.en: Base URL of the Draco decoder, fetched only when a model needs it.
description.zh: Draco 解码器的基础网址，仅在模型需要时加载。

description.en: Called after an asset finishes loading.
description.zh: 素材加载完成后调用。

description.en: Called when an asset fails to load.
description.zh: 素材加载失败时调用。

description.en: Classes applied to the wrapper element.
description.zh: 应用到包装元素的 CSS 类。

dependencies.frameworkNote: Solid uses solid-js; Preact uses preact. Other framework dependencies follow the target project.

install.behavior: Commands are metadata only. This catalog and CLI never execute installation.

browserNotes: WebGPU builds need a browser with WebGPU; verify the current browser support before choosing a renderer.
HTML-in-Canvas is experimental. Check the component's current upstream browser/fallback documentation. Do not assume DOM capture works in every browser.
